newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST-China Sept industrial output up 10.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-China Sept industrial output up 10.8 pct.

text.p: China's industrial output is forecast at 158 billion yuan in September, up by a year-on-year 10.8 percent, the State Information Centre said in a forecast published in the China Securities on Tuesday.
It forecast accumulated industrial output for the first nine months at 1.37 trillion yuan, up by 12.7 percent year-on-year.
It forecast that output would stop its decline and stabilise at the end of September. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
